answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates an atlas of verified identities to secure the network. Each unique registration serves as a pearl of scarcity, forcing an attacker to control real human biological data to forge a ledge of legitimacy. By linking digital agency to physical uniqueness, the system imposes a prohibitive financial and operational cost that renders the mass creation of fraudulent identities economically unsustainable for any hostile adversary.
